nextExecutableAction: Root reviews this preflight, commits its wave0 work, resolves immutable reference delivery hashes and issues a clean revision-bound implementation packet only after LSX-WP-001/007/010/011/016 have accepted implementation and readback receipts plus affected EG-EFFECTS/identity/Drive foundations. Before worker dispatch, identify approved transport/query/detail/lifecycle/i18n registration seams and acquire the page.ts lease; re-hash/re-read changed sources. The worker then implements only the four normative new files against those accepted interfaces, sends the PageConfig/descriptor patch request to the integration owner, and executes all six separate proof lanes on the integrated version.
risks: Published RS-BASE-01 says new registered CustomRecord kind and proposed Postgres payload, whereas this refined package explicitly requires initial kind=page/contentKind=record with no global new kind or duplicate store. Follow the refined A+B boundary and have root record the reconciliation; do not change ROX2_ENTITY_KINDS under this package.

The current authorized shared patch list contains only PageKind/PageConfig. Actual transport/query/detail routing, locale edits and lifecycle registration may need additional existing-file changes. Those require accepted dependency registration interfaces or a reviewed scope amendment, not guessed patch locations.

PageConfig.grants are HTML source-action approvals bound to index.html digests; reusing them as record field ACL would authorize the wrong object. authorizeRox2Action alone is not entity/field policy enforcement.

parseRox2TypedRecord accepts generic properties and preserves future raw input only in its result. It does not validate the 18 field types, retain durable original bytes, implement CAS or guarantee safe future-version UI.

record.create/patchFields/get API list does not name delete/history operations although the UI contract requires soft-delete/history. Reuse and verify native lifecycle APIs; do not waive this requirement or invent a second history store.
Optional body and record fields can cross commit boundaries; exact ownership, ACL intersection, failure receipt and recovery must be established before showing combined success.

Unknown schema fields, type migrations and later acknowledged writes can be lost if payload decoders rebuild only known fields or rollback replaces whole snapshots. Preserve raw/versioned data and use accepted WP016 repair semantics.
Source hashes may become stale during root integration. This is preflight lineage only; accepted implementation receipts must bind the new committed version and recomputed evidence.

A green isolated test, screenshot, event notification or queued provider receipt cannot establish canonical persistence, shared identity or full feature completion. All mandatory native, restart, policy and actual Electron lanes remain unverified.
